title: RevClamp AdPulse - For Google Ads Transparency Center (MCP & Apify Actor)

query.title: Brand Name or Domain
query.description: Brand name or domain to match against verified Google Ads Transparency advertiser entities (e.g. 'nike.com', 'Stripe', 'shopify.com').

domain.title: Brand Domain (Optional Alias)
domain.description: Optional alias for query (advertiser domain, e.g. 'nike.com', 'stripe.com').

brand.title: Brand Name (Optional Alias)
brand.description: Optional alias for query (brand name, e.g. 'Nike', 'Stripe').

company.title: Company Name (Optional Alias)
company.description: Optional alias for query (company name, e.g. 'Stripe', 'Shopify').

advertiser.title: Advertiser Name (Optional Alias)
advertiser.description: Optional alias for query (advertiser name, e.g. 'Nike, Inc.', 'Stripe, Inc.').

url.title: Website or Transparency URL (Optional Alias)
url.description: Optional alias for query (website URL or adstransparency.google.com URL).

advertiserId.title: Advertiser ID (Optional)
advertiserId.description: Optional Google Ads Transparency Advertiser ID (e.g. 'AR16735076323512287233'). When provided, queries this exact advertiser directly.

countryCode.title: Country Filter (Optional)
countryCode.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code filter (e.g. 'US'). Leave blank for all regions.

country.title: Country Code (Optional Alias)
country.description: Optional alias for countryCode (2-letter ISO country code, e.g. 'US').

region.title: Region Code (Optional Alias)
region.description: Optional alias for countryCode (2-letter ISO country code or 'ALL').

formatFilter.title: Ad Format
formatFilter.description: Filter returned ad creatives by format (ALL, TEXT, IMAGE, or VIDEO).

includeSubsidiaries.title: Include Regional Subsidiaries
includeSubsidiaries.description: When enabled, matches up to 3 verified regional legal entities for the same brand (e.g. Stripe, Inc. US and Stripe Payments Europe, Limited IE).

includeCreativeDetails.title: Include Creative Region & Legal Details
includeCreativeDetails.description: When enabled, fetches detailed regional presence and legal entity records for up to 10 returned creatives (default 5).

includeAdCopy.title: Include Static Ad Copy (Optional)
includeAdCopy.description: When enabled alongside Include Creative Region & Legal Details, extracts static headline, body text, CTA, and destination domain from allowlisted preview scripts without eval.

maxEntities.title: Max Advertiser Entities
maxEntities.description: Maximum number of verified advertiser entities to query when regional subsidiaries are included (1 to 3).

maxResults.title: Max Creatives to Extract
maxResults.description: Maximum number of deduplicated ad creatives to extract in this run (1 to 200).

max_results.title: Max Results (Optional Snake-Case Alias)
max_results.description: Optional snake_case alias for maxResults (1 to 200).

cursor.title: Next-Page Pagination Cursor (Optional)
cursor.description: Optional continuation cursor returned by a previous run to resume from the next creative.
